entities.summary: Julia Zwehl is a former field hockey international from Germany. She played as goalkeeper and was a member of the German gold medal winning team at the 2004 Olympics in Athens. Zwehl, nicknamed Zorro, played for Eintracht Braunschweig. In total, she represented Germany in 93 matches. Julia Zwehl was a athletes & competitors from Hanover (b. 1976-03-20, Hanover). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
